author: Home Repair Tutor
description: Copper pipe prep is important for this installation. I deburr the inside and outside of the pipe, then mark the depth. I like these push-to-connect ball valves because they’re fast, can accept copper or PEX, and spin 360 degrees, which is helpful when there’s an access panel
